title: Chapter 525
paragraphs: Chapter 525
Episode 144. For a Friend (3)
"...What's the size of the emperor's vanguard?"

"One thousand knights, one hundred mages, five dragons, the commander is Kevin Feral of the Dragon King Knights. The main knights include Scott Hollow of the Central Knights, Marvin Pan, Gloria Chendler of the Hundred Spear Knights. The commander of the mages is Loya Lillista, and most of them are made up of the second division of the Lillista Magic Squad."
"War artifacts confirmed include fifty lion-class cannons, three red dragon-class cannons, and numerous boundary amplification artifacts."
Even with just that, there weren't many nations in the world that couldn't be conquered. Single nations and families could not handle such power, except for the giant forces.
And the list recited by the commanders was just the vanguard. The main force that would arrive later was bound to be incomparable in size.
"The size of the main force has not been determined yet, but it is estimated to be at least ten times larger."
The atmosphere in the meeting room sank heavily.
Those who had guessed Ron's condition renewed their determination once more, and those who had not continued to think about the white stone.

"Three hours, that's faster than expected. The emperor must also know that Lord Ron can't fight. That's why he's rushing like this. The main force will probably arrive a few hours after the vanguard."
As Shuras said,
Snap-! Shuras suddenly split the long table in the meeting room in half and stood in front of Dante.
Then he kneeled on one knee and lowered his body.
"As the head of the Helter family, Shuras Helter, I and the knights of Helter who are not out of my control will share the fate with Hiran."
As Shuras pledged, other knights also knelt.
"Sellington will also fight with Hiran!"
"Without Hiran, Ropermo would have been extinct a long time ago. We will offer our modest help."
"Traga will stand by Hiran."
"Aklick will..."
In this way, thirty representatives of each family in the meeting room pledged to Dante and Hiran.
And seven people were left. They were the ones most disturbed by the news of Ron's unconsciousness.
After responding to the pledges with his sword on their shoulders, Dante silently gazed at them.
"Kingzel, Felishi, Metin, Byzellin, Pane, Metro, Zinion."
"Mr Dante, we are..."
"You have broken your faith with Hiran. You have forgotten the fact that my family, my grandfather, and my ancestors fought for your well-being."
At Dante's words, the representatives of the seven families couldn't lift their heads.
The knights still bowing their heads looked ready to cut off their necks as soon as Dante gave the order.

"However, I don't want to think that you abandoned your faith in Hiran out of fear for your personal lives and the survival of your families. I will consider that you chose to maintain loyalty to the Empire rather than your faith in Hiran. So before you leave, there will be something you need to do for the Empire."
"Please... tell us."
"Help evacuate the people of Sword Emperor City. If you will not even do that, then you did not choose loyalty, and I see no reason to spare you."
The seven knights who did not take the oath bowed their heads and left the meeting room.
"Lord Golo."
"Yes, Your Lordship!"
"Evacuate all the non-combatants and the people. If the seven families do not assist in the process, you may cut off their heads immediately."
"I understand."
"All the regular soldiers must also be evacuated."
The role of regular soldiers in battle is mostly equipment operation, supplies, guard duty, and post-war control.

If the regular soldiers are missing, lower-ranking knights would have to operate equipment like cannons directly, so there would be some loss of power. But Dante did not want them to bear such a harsh responsibility.
If they lose in the war, they would all be slaughtered, including their families, just for standing on the walls.
Once the evacuation was complete, the only people left in the city were three thousand regular knights, a thousand high-ranking knights, and fifty commander-level knights including Dante.
They could handle the vanguard, but they were woefully inadequate to face the whole Empire.
Dante and the commanders went up to the walls.
Restoration had been ongoing since the last terrorist attack, but Sword Emperor City had not yet fully regained its old appearance.
There were cracks left in the walls everywhere, and many places were completely empty.

It was not a fight for defense anyway. The regular soldiers were all sent out, and more than half of the war equipment was damaged during the terror attack, so they couldn't hold out in the city for long.
Regardless of the outcome of the war, Sword Emperor City would end today.
Dante just wanted to imprint this landscape in his eyes for the last time, so he climbed onto the walls.
-I get what you're saying. But what if the royal family chooses Zipfel and decides to finish off Hiran with us?
-You'll have to stop that.
-I'm not the head of Zipfel, I'm the next head. Do you think I have that kind of authority?
-That's a joke, by then Runcandel will join Hiran.
As the commanders ordered, the tents set up below the walls were removed, and people started evacuating. Suddenly, the voices of his friends came to mind.
When he had asked Beradin with Jin to pressure Zipfel to press Hiran more.
The three of them had considered the possibility of such a full-scale war to some extent.
However, Ron losing his consciousness entirely and the Emperor revealing Hiran's secret to the world were completely unexpected problems.
Especially, who could have imagined that Ron would be unable to fight?

The injuries Ron suffered during the Sword Emperor City terror attack were not supposed to be this severe. It was a normal injury that should have healed in a week at the shortest, or a month at the longest.
Dante did not know why Ron's injury had worsened to this extent.
'With Grandfather unable to wake up, even if Jin comes now, I can't see us winning this war.'
The thought of getting Jin's help felt like pulling a friend into a quagmire.
Jin was not yet the head of Runcandel. And Hiran, without Ron, objectively had no value that Runcandel could gain while confronting the Empire.
Dante received paper and a pen from a commander standing next to him. It was to send a letter to Jin, telling him not to send support.
"Send this to Tikan immediately."
The commander took the letter and went down the wall.
If Jin came, he had a high chance of surviving. Even if he couldn't lead all of Runcandel as he had said in his conversation with Beradin, he would surely bring enough troops to save him.
But Dante was sure that it was right to fight and die together here rather than choosing to escape and survive alone.
Thousands of warriors were risking their lives for Hiran. It was impossible for him, the red child of Sword Emperor City, to prioritize his own life over theirs.
Knights began to be deployed throughout the city following the orders of Dante and the commanders. The eyes of the knights were filled with the heavy resolve of a desperate fight.
Now, all that was left was to wait for the enemies to come.
"A white stone? Are they saying they'll destroy Sword Emperor City for that reason?"
Rosa, who was examining the report, frowned.
"We have never obtained any information about this white stone. It could just be a lie for justification."
"It might be true. But that's not important. If the Emperor is moving like this, he must be confident that he can defeat Ron's Sword Emperor City."
"Since the Sword Emperor City terror, Ron Hiran has almost stopped external activities. And there has been no activity at all for the past two weeks."
"As we suspected before, he might be unable to fight... Seeing that there's no reaction even though the Emperor has raised an army, it's almost certain."
"Although there hasn't been any significant movement yet, Zipfel might be backing the Emperor."
"If that white stone is worth as much as the Emperor said, they definitely will."
"Should we prepare the knights?"
Instead of responding to the scribe's words, Rosa took a moment to think about her youngest son.
"'The 12th generation?"
"It is certain that they are within Tikan, but due to the order of the family head, we cannot determine the exact situation inside."
"That child will certainly go to Gyeomhwangseong. The sudden vacation request from the 4th generation is likely related to this."
"Without permission from the acting family head, he is going to lead the knights of Runcandell to support Gyeomhwangseong...."
"It's nothing new. When has the youngest ever acted with such consideration? Plus, even without the family's knights, the youngest has his own solid power."
Munsa bowed his head.
'We do not know exactly what the white stone that Hyeran possesses is, but seeing how anxious the emperor is about it, it wouldn't hurt to take it.'

However, it was burdensome to step forward without any information or justification. If the white stone turned out to be of no particular value, Runcandell would only be intervening in the empire's civil war without any gain.

"Let's watch how the youngest handles things first. But if we detect that Jipil or Kinsello are taking active steps, we should move accordingly. Keep watching their movements. Also, make a statement that Runcandell has nothing to do with this Hyeran civil war."
That way, if Jin's actions led to a bad result, they could naturally take the position that it was not the judgment of the entire Runcandell.
On the contrary, if things turned out well, it would only highlight the ability and determination of Runcandell's 12th generation.
"Yes, Acting Family Head."
The emperor's vanguard arrived in the plains of Gyeomhwangseong.
Dante stood in the middle of the castle's main gate watching them.

Five dragons, a thousand knights, a hundred magicians, fifty-three gates of cannons and barriers were pointing at Gyeomhwangseong's main gate. They didn't bother about the back or side gates, as their main force would surround them anyway.

"I am Kevin Ferrell, the vanguard commander of His Majesty Amir Biment's civil war suppression army, the great emperor of the empire! Ron Hyeran, the lord of Gyeomhwangseong, come out and receive and follow the Emperor's decree!"
Kevin Ferrell shouted at Gyeomhwangseong while looking down from his dragon.

Dante and the commanders did not respond to his words. Seeing this, Kevin grew even more arrogant and raised his voice. Although he had heard it from the emperor beforehand, he had just confirmed with his own two eyes that Ron was unable to fight.
"Is Ron Hyeran absent? Then, the minor lord, Dante Hyeran, should receive and follow the Emperor's decree. This is the final warning...!"
That's it!
He was about to shout that, but Kevin suddenly felt a chilly sensation like the wind entering the middle of his chest.
His chest had been pierced.
Kevin did not realize it at the moment, but it was something that happened right after something had flashed once on the wall of Gyeomhwangseong.
The light was from Dante drawing his sword and firing a sword aura. The aura that pierced Kevin's chest had already returned to the scabbard, and only a few people were able to perceive its speed.
As Kevin began to fall from the dragon, Dante said,
"There is no one in the Empire who dares to look down on Gyeomhwangseong. Even if it's the Emperor. So, if anyone wants to convey the Emperor's will, defeat me and then speak."
